behavior.prestock: Boolean vehicle metadata only; registering a vehicle does not create a payment or change the shared prestock ledger.
behavior.money: Existing KRW fields and daily interest model are reused. Loan principal is not added to acquisition costs; omitted inventoryStartedAt retains purchase-date fallback.
behavior.success: Only after server-confirmed vehicle persistence, show 저장 되었습니다. and reveal the new vehicle first on purchase page1, in list or card mode. Reduced motion retains static feedback.
behavior.retry: A staged failed or lost acknowledgement resumes the same vehicle ID; stale account/modal responses cannot show completion.
behavior.optionalIdentityCompatibility: Ordinary detail edits allow a missing plate with the existing account/company/owner/role/car checks; Encar still requires a normalized plate. Missing mileage stays blank and clearing a known mileage remains rejected.

validation.independentReview: No blocking findings; generic edit authorization retains prior guards and strict Encar plate validation.
validation.browserMethod: Actual index and assets in Chromium with synthetic auth, HTTP and owner-CAS persistence; no live credentials or business records.

knownBaselineTestFailures.assertion: At1024px the existing body uses grid but this legacy assertion expects block.
Existing document share button is in the header while the legacy assertion expects it below.

baselineFailureHandling: Unrelated committed assertions remain intact. Temporary targeted copies omit only those proven baseline assertions; changed registration checks and unchanged drawer geometry/close behavior pass.
limitations: No production vehicle was registered or edited during testing. Actual production Auth/database responses are not represented by the synthetic browser fixtures.
